inlines.v: PLAT'TING, noun Work done by platting or interweaving. PLAT, noun [Latin latus; or from the root of place.] A small piece of ground, usually a portion of flat even ground; as a flowery plat; a plat of willows. PLAT, adjective Plain; flat. [Not used.] PLAT, adverb Plainly; flatly; downright. [Not used.] 1. Smoothly; evenly. [Not used.]
